content: Kilke te tuku maŋau ndoŋ ulendi ndakap
Ŋgarosu tuku nzali yimyam taŋgine wamdus sinamŋge kame bumba minig. Ta tuku tane kualeyauka pasambi kame bude.

Tane wam afu kilam idusde ta tane kilam fugumba ande balewam idusde. Tane wam afu kilam tuku am kikoŋ tiŋgade ta kilam fugumba kualeyauka kame bude. Tane Kuate wam afu yabaŋ ndade tukunu tane wam ta denkanu minig.
Ko tane wam afu kilam tuku Kuate yabaŋde ta tane taŋgine nzali dubikam idusde tukunu Kuate nu nda tiŋgit.

Tane Kuate ndo idus ndade. Ande nu kilke te tuku maŋau ndoŋ ulendikate ta nu Kuate tuku ŋgueu minit. Wam ta tane kila. Tane kilke te tuku maŋau ndoŋ ulendikam idusde ta tane Kuate tuku ŋgueu taŋgo mayok kinig.
Kuate tuku pasa ande teŋenmba sakate. Tukul Guwa Kuate nu siŋgina ta sine Kuate ndo idusam tuku nu saŋgri ŋak sine kulatkate.
Ŋgarosu tuku nzali yimyam kile-ibeŋka Kuate ndo idusam tuku nu ake sinaŋ sine lato lato make patikate. Kuate tuku pasa ande teŋenmba sakate.

content.text: Mbe mbolmbolkade mbal Kuate nu nane ndoŋ ŋgueu minit. Nyu te-ibeŋmba minig mbal nu ake sinaŋ nane make patikate ŋgate. Sindaun 3.34

content: Ta tuku tane ŋgan patika Kuate kumnemŋge minmba tane saŋgri tiŋga dirnaŋga minap le Satan nu tane kusreka kua kaŋgat.
Tane Kuate tugum kape le nu tane tugum prowamŋgat. Tane mbarde mbal tane taŋgine une maŋau kusrekap. Wamdus ar ar ŋak minig mbal tane wamdus ŋaigonu kusrekap sulumba wamdus ndindo ŋak purfeŋnu minap.
Tane taŋgine une tuku sinanu Kuate am mbolŋge malmbikap. Taŋgine nzumilkade maŋau mbilmba wamdus piti suŋgo tap. Tane gare maŋau mbilmba ye mbaren ŋga kikonu lok minap.
Tane taŋawap ta Suŋgo nu tane kilmba kile-mayokkamŋgat.
Tira ande pile ndawap

O tira kame, tane taŋgine taŋgine muŋgu ŋgumnem pasa sa ndakap. Ande nu tira ande tuku ŋgumnem pasa sakate ko nu pilete ta nu Kuate tuku tukul turmba ŋgumnem pasa tumba pilete. Ne Kuate tuku tukul pilete ta ne tukul ta dubi ndate. Ne tukul tuku ma tumba naŋe ma ta tukulŋge tate le ne tukul tuku pile taŋgo mayok kinit.
Kuateŋge ndo tukul kile-mayokka sine tuku pile taŋgo minit. Ande mine ndakate. Nuŋge ndo sine tuku muskil kile-tidiŋgam kumuŋ. Nuŋge ndo sine pitaikam kumuŋ. Ne ima le tira ande pilete?
Payamkam tuku maŋau kuraukap
Tane afu teŋenmba sakade. Kite ko indole ye tumbraŋ suŋgo ande mbol kumba taŋge yar ndindo piroka ndametiŋ suŋgomba kilamŋgit ŋgade. Tane taŋamba sakade mbal pasa te isap.
Indole wam ande prowam tuku ta tane gilai minig. Tane tuku abo guwa bidu taŋaŋ kile kaŋgereg le pitik kugate taŋaŋ.
Ta tuku tane teŋenmba sakap: Kuate nuŋe nzali dubiwa le sine abo minbe sulumba sine taŋamba taŋamba kamŋgig ŋga sakap.
Tane mbe mbolmbolka taŋgine ŋgarosu ndo payamkade maŋau ta ŋakmba ŋaigonu ndo.
Tane wam magenu kam tuku kila ŋak minmba ke ndakap ta tane mbarde.
